messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v2/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units: if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks; if the customer will send them later, the assistant explains that they must arrive first and requests nothing for them now."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same units was created in time and then expired, or stopped being valid because the order or this policy changed, before it was paid, a later request for those units is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case. A proposal that the customer replaced or cancelled, that a staff member rejected, or that a handoff closed does not count. A request for an exception to the time limit is refused with this reason."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "A person takes over the conversation when the customer asks for one, at any time; when the shop's decision on a request is that a staff member takes the case; or in a case this policy names: units the customer says were sent but have not arrived, a delivered order the customer says never arrived, and a request to refund shipping. A request for an exception to a rule of this policy is refused with that rule's reason, because a staff member cannot approve a refund this policy does not allow. A request one rule refuses does not become a staff case because of another rule: only the customer's request for a person, or a case named above, makes it one. After a refusal the assistant gives the reason, and the customer can still ask for a person. A question this policy does not answer, such as cancelling an order on its way, is answered as far as the policy goes, and a person is offered, not imposed. When a person takes over, every proposal of the conversation that is not paid is closed, and the person continues from there; a refund already paid stays paid."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
